_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or derived from extracted values by a rule stated beside it.

human_share_min_pct.basis: share of written responses routed to human scorers, at least

engine_record_pct.basis: approximate share of responses whose score of record the engine assigns

spanish_human_pct.basis: share of Spanish-language written responses scored by people

training_sample.basis: human scored field test responses the engine is programmed on, per item

cost_low_m.basis: low end of the yearly cost of full human scoring, millions of dollars

students_credited.basis: students who received additional credit in the annual review

improved_pct.basis: share of exams reviewed whose scores improved

districts_affected.basis: districts the agency named as affected, counted from the list in the quote

per4_engine.basis: of every 4 responses, rule: engine_record_pct x 4 / 100

per4_people.basis: of every 4 responses, rule: human_share_min_pct x 4 / 100

per1000_improved.basis: of every 1,000 exams reviewed, rule: round(improved_pct x 1000 / 100)
